summary: Controller APIs moved to the platform gateway in 2.6: /api/v2/organizations, teams and users to /api/gateway/v1/..., /api/v2/roles to /api/gateway/v1/role_definitions/, and role grants and team or user role lists to role_team_assignments and role_user_assignments; the 2.4 endpoints are deprecated but still work in 2.6.
questions: How do I give a user a role through the AAP 2.6 API?
Do the old /api/v2/organizations endpoints still work?
How do I list a team's roles in AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: Role and user APIs in AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- Users, teams, organizations: `/api/gateway/v1/users/`, `/teams/`, `/organizations/`.
- Role list: `/api/gateway/v1/role_definitions/` (includes custom roles).
- Grant a role: `POST /api/gateway/v1/role_user_assignments/` or `/role_team_assignments/`.
- A user's or team's roles: `/api/gateway/v1/role_user_assignments/?user={id}`, `/role_team_assignments/?team={id}`.

The 2.4 `/api/v2/...` endpoints still work in 2.6 but are deprecated.
